DEVELOPMENT PL AN REVIEW BO ARD
  MINUTES
  MAY 25, 2023 at 8:30 AM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE
  COUNCIL CONFERENCE ROOM

  BOARD MEMBERS PRESENT

  David Bratt, Planning Commission
  Brad McKinney, Assistant City Manager
  Shari Garwick, Director of Public Works
  Henry Noh, Director of Community Development

  BOARD MEMBERS ABSENT

  Scott Dilley, Chamber of Commerce
  John Sorcinelli, Public Member at Large

  STAFF PRESENT

  Eric Beilstein, Building & Safety Manager
  Luis Torrico, Planning Manager
  Anne Nguyen, Senior Planner
  Ken Fichtelman, Associate Planner
  James Miclat, Planning Intern
  Victoria Gutierrez, Departmental Assistant

CALL TO ORDER

David Bratt called the regular meeting of the Developmental Plan Review Board to order at 8:36
a.m. so as to conduct regular business in the Council Conference Room.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Director of Community Development Noh moved, seconded by Building and Safety Manager
Beilstein, to approve the February 9, 2023 Development Plan Review Board minutes. Motion
carried 4-0-2 (Beilstein voted in substitute of McKinney, Dilley and Sorcinelli absent).

Assistant City Manager McKinney moved, seconded by Director of Community Development
Noh, to approve the March 9, 2023 Development Plan Review Board Minutes. Motion carried 3-
0-3 (Bratt abstained, Dilley and Sorcinelli absent).

Assistant City Manager McKinney moved, seconded by Director of Community Development
Noh, to approve the March 23, 2023 Development Plan Review Board Minutes. Motion carried 3-
0-3 (Garwick abstained, Dilley and Sorcinelli absent)
 DPRB Minutes  Page 2
May 25, 2023

PUBLIC HEARING

DPRB Case No. 23-0004D
Associated Case: ACCELA PROJ 23-0030

A request to remodel the exterior of the building (Applebee’s) located at 674 W. Arrow Highway.
The site is located within the San Dimas Station commercial center and within the Creative Growth
– Area 1 (CG-1) Zone (APN: 8386-007-078).

Victoria Robbins, a representative of Applebee’s SoCal II LLC, was present.

Senior Planner Nguyen presented the staff report and recommended Board approval.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein asked if the proposed gooseneck lighting is new and what
color is proposed.

Senior Planner Nguyen stated the gooseneck lighting proposed on page 17 of the staff report
will replace the existing fixtures and be a bronze color.

Applebee’s Representative Robbins stated the new fixtures will match the doors.

Planning Manager Torrico stated the new signage will be submitted to the Planning Division
separately for Staff review.

Director of Public Works Garwick asked what the lifespan of Hardie Board is.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein stated Hardie Board is a fiber cement product and has a
significantly longer lifespan than wood siding. He added installation, quality of nails used, and
other factors have an effect on durability.

There were no further comments to be heard.

Motion DPRB Case No. 23-0004D

Director of Public Works Garwick moved to approve DPRB Case No. 23-0004D subject to the
conditions of approval.

Motion seconded by Assistant City Manager McKinney

Motion carried 4-0-2 (Dilley and Sorcinelli absent).

Tree Removal Permit No. 23-0002
Associated Case: ACCELA PROJ 23-0005

A request to remove four (4) mature trees within HOA common area at Cinnamon Creek, 1367
Cypress Street (APN: 8385-018-040).

Jeff Ludwig, a representative of Park West Tree Care, was present.

Associate Planner Fichtelman presented the staff report and recommended Board approval.
 DPRB Minutes  Page 3
May 25, 2023

Planning Manager Torrico stated Staff received two comments from the Public; one in favor and
one in opposition of the project.

Director of Public Works Garwick stated Tree ID #1 is a Pine, but the replacement proposed is
Golden Medallion. She asked who chose the replacement tree types.

Associate Planner Fichtelman stated the arborist did.

Planning Manager Torrico stated if there are concerns about space for the replacement trees,
Staff may direct the arborist to choose a different location or a different type of tree that would be
appropriate for that space.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein asked if Tree ID #2 that is causing damage to the nearby
sidewalk also has past limb failures.

Associate Planner Fichtelman stated the Applicant has documented limb failures that have
caused damage to nearby structures.

Park West Tree Care Representative, Ludwig stated the company has been trimming
Cinnamon Creek HOA trees for a year and Tree ID #2 is very close to the private backyard of
1385 Cypress Street. He stated the roots have intruded the back patio of the residence causing
additional issues. He added that because the tree is so large, any limb failures would cause
significant damage and danger.

Mr. Bratt stated the Board has recommended the minimum size of replacement trees be
increased from 15-gallon to 24-inch box in the past. He stated the Board’s intention was to ensure
large trees were replaced with trees of similar size.

Associate Planner Fichtelman stated the conditions currently call for replacement trees with a
minimum height of eight feet and a minimum canopy of three feet but the Board can require larger
replacement trees.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein proposed requiring a smaller replacement ratio but with
larger replacement trees.

Associate Planner Fichtelman stated that is possible, but he would not recommend it for Tree
ID #3 and #4 because they are located near buildings where smaller trees would be more
appropriate.

Planning Manager Torrico proposed the Board require that all replacement trees be a minimum
of 24-inch box size and the location be revised if it cannot accommodate a tree of that size.

Park West Tree Care Representative, Ludwig stated Cinnamon Creek HOA would be flexible
with location and size of replacement trees.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein proposed the Board also add a condition that Park West
Tree Care use techniques like deep root watering on the replacement trees to encourage the
roots to grow deep.
 DPRB Minutes  Page 4
May 25, 2023

Park West Tree Care Representative, Ludwig stated Park West Tree Care does not perform
maintenance but he would recommend deep root watering to the maintenance company on-site.

Resident of Cinnamon Creek, Pete Donnallan stated he owns a townhome just under the
canopy of one of the trees requested for removal, he stated Tree ID #3 is within an open area and
he thinks it looks fine.

Associate Planner Fichtelman stated the arborist report locates Tree ID #3 as fifteen feet away
from structures and has had multiple limb failures.

Park West Tree Care Representative, Ludwig stated there is also lifting of concrete in that area.

Associate Planner Fichtelman stated Page 31 of the staff report shows that all four trees
requested for removal are close to residences with their canopies directly over existing structures.

Resident of Cinnamon Creek, Pete Donnallan stated the Eucalyptus trees on the east side of
the property are a nuisance and he was under the impression those would be requested for
removal.

Park West Tree Care Representative, Ludwig stated a couple of those trees have started to
show signs of disease but would be requested for removal separately.

Motion Tree Removal Permit No. 23-0002

Director of Community Development Noh moved to approve TRP Case No. 23-0002 with the
following revisions to the conditions of approval;
  • A reduced (1:1) replacement ratio has been approved. The replacement trees consist of
  a Golden Medallion, Raywood Ash, Cork Oak, and a Sweetshade tree. Each of the
  replacement trees will planted in the same general location where the existing trees to be
  removed are located. The Applicant shall work with Staff to determine the final location of
  all replacement trees. *For the purpose of replacement trees, fruit trees and palms
  are not considered canopy trees.
  • All replacement trees shall be a 24-inch box minimum and have a minimum height of eight
  (8) feet measured from finished grade to the top of the canopy, and a minimum canopy
  width of three (3) feet at the time of planting. All tree plantings shall utilize a deep root
  watering system.
  • The Applicant shall make a good faith effort to submit a master tree removal and
  replacement plan for the entire property for future tree removals.

Motion seconded by Assistant City Manager McKinney.

Motion carried 4-0-2 (Dilley, Sorcinelli absent)

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

There were no comments to be heard.

ADJOURNMENT
There being no further business the meeting was adjourned at 9:04 a.m. to the meeting of June
8, 2023.
